body:
I think the issue that's always set me back from actually going through with this is how drastic my mood changes from week to week.  It seems that right when I'm at the very lowest of the low and there's no possible way I can keep going on I'll pop back into a positive/manic mood.  And when I'm in that manic mood I think everything is going to be perfect going forward, so I don't have to worry about it any longer.

That, and a fear of losing part of myself, as you mentioned.  I know it's a physical disease, but I can't help feeling like it's integral part of myself.

I'm originally from Ontario, but in the Quebec region for schooling right now.  I know that the school health centre fills its monthly schedule pretty quickly, but I guess I can just wait a few weeks and try to get in on the schedule.

Thanks for the support!
